coverage_note: Toolchain for all probes: node v24.20.0, npm 10.9.4, pnpm 10.34.5, yarn 1.22.22 (single versions; packageManager pins not honored with version switching — e.g. pheralb/slug pins pnpm@8.15.6 and its old pnpm-lock.yaml files were rejected by pnpm 10 as lockfile-breaking-change; logotip4ik/portfolio pins yarn@3.6.0 but was probed with yarn 1.22.22, its failures were network errors not version errors). A VM reboot mid-task wiped /usr/bin/pnpm and /usr/bin/yarn (non-persistent); both reinstalled to /usr/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin, and every record probed while the toolchain was missing was fully re-probed (achamorro-dev/eventoswiki, samuelkraft/samuelkraft-next). One worker mistakenly deleted two of another worker's worktree dirs; affected record satnaing/satnaing.dev was fully re-probed (broken, 6/6 install 4/6 build, genuine webpack errors). Sporadic transient checkout glitches (worktree missing package.json immediately after a successful checkout) hit single commits in hyperlink-academy/leaflet, alanagoyal/alanagoyal, w3bdesign/nextjs-woocommerce, jackblatch/OneStopShop and one run of santifer/cv-santiago; only santifer's verdict hinged on one, and its full re-probe still failed that commit (build timeout >300s while fetching live API data) — verdict broken either way; other verdicts unaffected. Sandbox EPERM chown flakes during npm bin-linking and Next.js .next/cache writes were classified as environment (seen in prior scans of this machine). PasteBar/PasteBarApp: 4 build failures were missing cargo/Rust (tauri), reclassified from build to environment per the missing-system-toolchain rule; verdict unchanged (2 genuine install failures). samuelkraft/samuelkraft-next: 5 yarn registry fetch aborts, registries verified reachable via curl and probe run twice — recorded as install failures. jackblatch/OneStopShop is environment_incomplete: 5/6 installs and the 1 attempted build were blocked by sandbox EPERM flakes, so no clean verdict was possible; it is not counted in usable. Stage-0 exclusions (framework-owned, tool-docs, template) were applied before stage-1 records were written, so rejected_by_reason only breaks out stage-1 rejections. Two stage2_list keys lack the '/' separator (jestsee_jestsee.com, alexcarpenter_alexcarpenter.me), inherited from stage 1; probed as jestsee/jestsee.com and alexcarpenter/alexcarpenter.me via existing clones.
